description: Returns a Forever profession leveling route between skill levels: agreed steps, summed reagents and estimated cost, leaving uncovered ranges as gaps. A reported recipe or orange skill range needs 3 agreeing installs. Costs use median reagent prices from at least 3 distinct installs: unscoped observations without realm, build or observation time, not one listing's price or a current realm minimum. Agreed vendor prices may supply reagent costs; training is listed separately. Use recipe_thresholds for colour-change ranges. Use market_value with a verified item gameId and full realm name for a dated realm price. Missing prices stay unknown, never free.

fromSkill.description: Skill the character has now, 1 to 500, default 1.

toSkill.description: Skill to stop at, 1 to 500, above fromSkill.

name: profession_path

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

copper.description: The whole path's reagent cost; null when any price is unrecorded.

gaps.description: Skill ranges no agreed recipe covers; a gap is left, never invented.

reagents.description: Every reagent the path needs, summed.

copper.description: Reagent cost of the step; null when a price is unrecorded.

trainingCopper.description: Derived steps only: agreed training cost, or null when unrecorded.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Profession leveling path
